name: @aily-project/board-nano-stm32f103vx
description: NANO_STM32F103VX_V520 development board configuration (SanZhi LanJing / Three Blue Whales), based on STM32F103VET6 (compatible with VC/VD/VG). Onboard: LED0(PB5)/LED1(PE5), KEY0(PE4)/KEY1(PE3)/WK_UP(PA0), passive buzzer(PB8), IR receiver(PB9), NTC(PC5), DHT11/DS18B20(PD1), W25Q16 SPI flash(PB12-15), SD card(SDIO PC8-12/PD2), RS485(PB10/11,PE0), SPI/IIC OLED, USB(PA11/12), integrated ST-LINK V2.1 and CH340.
